title: Faculty Info The Patricia Bauman and John Landrum Bryant Senior Lecturer on Arts in Education, Emeritus Degrees Ed.D., Harvard University, (1995)
bio: Steve Seidel studies the use of reflective practices in schools, the close examination of student work, the documentation of individual and group learning, and the quality of arts learning and teaching. His current research looks at working artists insights into the nature of artistic development.
research_interests: With deep expertise that connects research
